P = (x^2+2x+2)(x^2-2x+5); the cycle around the conjugate pair -1 +- i equals twice the branch-cut segment integral, computed here by direct quadrature along x(t) = -1 + i(2t-1) with an explicitly continuous sqrt branch (P(x(t)) = 4t(1-t) * ((8-(2t-1)^2) - 4i(2t-1)), second factor Re >= 7 so its principal sqrt never jumps) at 90 dps.
